EN ESPERA DE CIA. VETCO GREY PARA RECUPERAR BUJE DE DESGASTE. EN EL INTER: PERSONAL CIA. PROPESA Y UNIDAD DE PRUEBAS, PROBÓ ENSAMBLE DE ESTRANGULACIÓN (VALVULA X VALVULA) CON 300 PSI EN BAJA Y 8000 PSI. EN ALTA BIEN. PERSONAL CIA. IPC PROBO BOMBAS DE LODOS CON NUEVA HIDRAULICA 5-1/2"X11" Y REVISO MOTOR ELECTRICO N. 1 DEL MALACATE PRINCIPAL.

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: Waiting for VETCO GREY company to recover wear bushing. In the interim: PROPESA company personnel and test unit tested choke assembly (valve by valve) with 300 PSI low and 8000 PSI high OK. IPC company personnel tested mud pumps with new 5-1/2"X11" hydraulics and checked main drawworks electric motor N.1.

CON PERSONAL CIA. VETCO GRAY RECUPERO BUJE DE DESGASTE.

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: With VETCO GRAY company personnel recovered wear bushing.

CON UNIDAD DE CIA PROPESA INSTALO PROBADOR DE COPAS, INTENTO PROBAR BOPS 13-5/8"-10M S/E EN REPETIDAS OCASIONES. S/EXITO CAMBIO COPA INTENTO PROBAR NUEVAMENTE S/E. SACO PROBADOR A SUP Y CAMBIO X TAPON DE PRUEBAS CIA VETCO Y PROBO PREVENTOR ESFERICO 13-5/8"-10M CON 300PSI EN BAJA Y 7000PSI EN ALTA 40 MIN BIEN. HR. POR FALLA EN U. PRUEBAS. SE REPARO FALLA EN MANGUERA DE FLUIDO HIDRAULICO. SE INTENTO PROBAR PREVENTOR SUPERIOR DE ARIETES Y RAM CIEGO OBSERVANDO FUGA EN TAPON DE PRUEBA.'O' RING. SE CONECTO PROBADOR DE COPAS CON EXTENSION E INTENTO PROBAR NUEVAMENTE S/E, SE OBSERVO QUE NO EMPACA COPA DE PRUEBA CIA PROPESA. SE SOLICITO OTRA COPA DE PRUEBA A CIA PROPESA, INSTALO COPA NUEVA E INTENTO PROBAR NUEVAMENTE S/E, LA COPA NO EMPACO. SE ESPERO TAPON DE PRUEBAS CIA VETCO Y SE INSTALO. AVANCE ACTUAL PRUEBA DE BOPSS 13-5/8"-10M CON 300PSI BAJA Y 8000PSI ALTA: 25%

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: With PROPESA company unit installed cup tester, attempted to test BOPs 13-5/8"-10M unsuccessfully on repeated occasions. Changed cup without success, attempted to test again unsuccessfully. Pulled tester to surface and changed for VETCO test plug and tested spherical preventer 13-5/8"-10M with 300PSI low and 7000PSI high for 40 min OK. Hour lost due to test unit failure. Repaired failure in hydraulic fluid hose. Attempted to test upper ram preventer and blind ram observing leak in test plug 'O' ring. Connected cup tester with extension and attempted to test again unsuccessfully, observed that PROPESA test cup does not pack. Requested another test cup from PROPESA, installed new cup and attempted to test again unsuccessfully, cup did not pack. Waited for VETCO test plug and installed. Current progress BOP test 13-5/8"-10M with 300PSI low and 8000PSI high: 25%

RESUM.DIA ANTER.: SACO BARRENA A 3,498 MT. REALIZO DESPLAZAMIENTO DE LODO DE 1.95 GR/CC X 2.05 GR/CC. ELIMINO ELEMENTO SELLANTE E INSTALO CAMPANA DE VIAJES. LEVANTO BNA A 989 M. PERSONAL IPC DESLIZO CABLE.

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: PREVIOUS DAY SUMMARY: Pulled bit to 3,498 M. Performed mud displacement from 1.95 g/cc to 2.05 g/cc. Removed sealing element and installed trip bell. Pulled bit to 989 M. IPC personnel slipped cable.

Resumen: SE PROBO PREVENTOR ANULAR 13-5/8" CON 300 PSI EN BAJA Y 7000PSI EN ALTA BIEN. SE PROBO PREVENTOR SUPERIOR DE ARIETES Y SE OBSERVO EN TAPON. SE ESPERO X TAPON DE PRUEBAS DE CIA VETCO. AVANCE 25% DE PRUEBA DE BOPS.

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: Summary: Tested annular preventer 13-5/8" with 300 PSI low and 7000PSI high OK. Tested upper ram preventer and observed leak in plug. Waited for VETCO company test plug. 25% progress on BOP test.

SGTE. OPERACIÓN: PROBAR BOPS, ARMAR SARTA CON BNA PDC 10-5/8" Y SARTA DIRECCIONAL. BAJAR A +/- 3,521 M. DESPLAZAR LODO 2.05 GR/CC X 1.95 GR/CC.

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: NEXT OPERATION: Test BOPs, make up string with PDC bit 10-5/8" and directional string. Run in hole to +/- 3,521 M. Displace mud 2.05 g/cc to 1.95 g/cc.

OBSERVACIONES: PERSONAL CIA. IPC CAMBIO HIDRAULICA DE LAS BOMBAS 1 Y 2 DEL EQUIPO A 5-1/2" X 11".

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: OBSERVATIONS: IPC company personnel changed hydraulics of pumps 1 and 2 of the rig to 5-1/2" X 11".

NOTA: POR PETICIÓN DE LA UNIDAD OPERATIVA, NO SE COLOCO GUARDA ROSCAS A LA TP 5 7/8" XT-57.

ENGLISH TRANSLATION: NOTE: Per operating unit request, no thread protectors placed on 5 7/8" XT-57 tubing.
